remarks: Sited in the highly sought-after Rolling Ridge community, this top-floor Essex model condominium offers a perfect blend of updates, convenience and tranquility. Featuring 2 spacious bedrooms, recent kitchen and and 2 remodeled full baths, this bright and sunny single-level unit was originally the builder's own and is set in the heart of Tudor-style buildings. The living space includes foyer, living room and dining area with sliders to a private deck/balcony, and picturesque views of the pond, lush trees, and vibrant birdlife. The recent modern white kitchen has quartz counters and stainless steel appliances. The master bedroom boasts an ensuite bath and ample closet space. Additional features include air conditioning, in-unit laundry, a storage unit in the basement, and access to the community pool and patio area. This is truly the home you've been waiting for, combining a peaceful setting with proximity to all your essential needs. As a plus, there is brand new carpeting and condo is freshly painted throughout. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges.
